risk_note: RV2 payout (withdraw lane B2-05k; model Claude Fable 5.1). payout's implementation of ledger's recovery port (B2-04ka BalanceRecoveredHook, BR-WDR-05 (a) / BR-FUND-12): inside the posting that takes a member's available from < 0 to >= 0, on the same transaction and inside ledger's voucher savepoint, one UPDATE clears blocked_reason = NEGATIVE_BALANCE on that member's withdrawals of this app (updated_at from the injected Clock, row_version + 1; no status change, no voucher, no event; a still-negative availableAfter is ignored). A failure rolls the voucher back. Wiring: PayoutModule.recovery() provides BALANCE_RECOVERED_HOOK globally on every non-stream entry so LedgerModule's LEDGER carries it; the apply use case and the worker's account.went_negative consumer pass the hook to their createLedger directly. B2-05e's transitional consumer-side clearing stays (frozen [AC-B2-05e#24]). No amounts or entries change.
